div.div: 7 انفأى It became split, or cloven, (S, M, K,) or cracked; (M, K;) said of a bowl [&c.]; (S, M;) as also ↓ تفأّى : (M, TA:) it opened, or became opened: (M, K:) it opened so as to form a break, or breach: (T, M, K:) it became laid open, uncovered, or exposed to view. (T, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
